title: Police Blotter: 26 booked in Webb County — end-of-day roundup
excerpt: 26 people were booked into the Webb County Jail on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds on Nov. 5–6, 2026 — including alleged DWI, assault, theft, and federal and immigration holds. Every arrest is an allegation; each person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.
content:
Twenty-six people were booked into the Webb County Jail on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds on Thursday and Friday, November 5 and 6, 2026, according to Webb County booking records. Each person is listed below with the charge shown in their booking record. An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction, and every person named here is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.
